title: 第1164章 前往神火峰淬体悟道第1163章 成功获得认可通行全峰
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
圣女殿清雅幽静，回廊两侧遍植珍稀的灵草奇葩与圣药，落日余晖倾洒而下，为整片殿宇镀上一层温润金芒。
株株灵植萦绕莹莹灵光，馥郁花香与醇厚药气交织相融，随风飘荡，沁入心肺，让人心神宁静，道心安宁。
相较于宗门其他地方，此殿内灵气更为纯粹浑厚，是宗门内顶尖的悟道之地。
侍女脚步轻盈，一路将李易引至圣女殿最僻静的西偏殿。
殿内一尘不染，灵雾萦绕，桌椅床榻皆是千年温玉所铸，空气中弥漫着淡淡的阴阳二气，修行底蕴与环境，远超宗门绝大多数核心弟子的居所。
侍女躬身垂首：
“石前辈，圣女吩咐，往后此处便是您的专属居所，奴婢居于隔壁偏舍，前辈若有任何需求，随时传唤即可。”
“很好，你去做自己的事吧。”
李易微微颔首，神态平和。
侍女不再多言，躬身退下，轻轻合上殿门。
殿门关闭的刹那，李易立即抬手一挥，五张道符飞出，化作五道流光分镇五方，瞬间构建出一个轻薄结界，将整座偏殿牢牢笼罩，隔绝一切声响外泄与神识探查。
随后。
他取出韩如雪所赐的帝级纯阳功法玉简，神识沉入其中，恢弘玄奥的纯阳大道心法霎时映入脑海。
“合欢宗帝级纯阳功法，道基正统，最高可修行到天神境圆满，倒是挺适配我如今伪装的身份。”
李易轻声自语，心中对韩如雪的为人多了几分认可。
这功法放在寻常修士眼中，乃是逆天机缘，可在他这里，仅仅只是用来掩人耳目的幌子。
他修行了阴阳混沌经、炼天术、太一吞天诀、八九通天玄功等无上功法，远超帝级功法。
他并未急着潜心修炼此功法，而是将整部功法熟记于心，转而清点起桌上的修行资源。
圣药、神泉、圣品灵石、养神固本道丹等琳琅满目，皆是合欢宗的珍稀至宝，随便一件流落外界，都足以引发众多修士厮杀争夺。
李易指尖轻点，将所有资源分门别类收纳妥当。

做完这一切，他掌心托起那枚温润的同心约令。
令牌之上，并蒂莲纹流转莹白微光，丝丝缕缕的玄阴道韵缠绕指尖，隐约与远在正殿闭关的韩如雪产生微妙共鸣。
一番细致感知探查。
李易不由发出感叹：“这竟是一件下品道器，合欢宗身为仙女星前三顶尖势力，底蕴之深，果然名不虚传，手笔着实惊人。”
随即。
他心念一动，指尖逼出一滴精纯的淡金色神血，精准落于令牌中心的并蒂莲蕊心之上。
“滋……”
精血入玉，瞬间被令牌吸纳消融，无半点外泄。
莹白剔透的玉令骤然亮起一圈柔和的阴阳光晕，莲纹层层绽放，一阴一阳两种道韵浩荡而出，与李易的神魂进行绑定。
刹那间。
令牌所有玄妙功用与操控之法尽数映入李易识海，清晰明了。
这枚道器令牌共有三种强大的技能。
其一，也是最重要的，便是与另一枚同心约隔空传音，互感位置，甚至能穿过大部分结界或禁制隔绝，传感距离可达亿里之遥。
其二，通行合欢宗一百零八峰非核心禁区，包括悟道场与藏经阁。
其三，遭遇致命危机时，可瞬息启动最强结界守护，抵挡普通神王一刻钟的攻势，同时向宗门最高信息祭台，发出求救信号与最后精准位置。
“今日来玄阴峰真是来对了，不仅得到了通行全峰的权限，还与宗主亲传弟子、第一圣女产生了深厚的因果，距离得到阴阳混沌经中卷又近了一大步。”
李易嘴角扬起一抹满意的笑容。
于他而言。
得罪黄冲霄、白齐天这些顶级天骄不过是无关痛痒的小事，只要能够步步逼近目标，一切风波皆可从容化解。
李易摩挲着掌心玉令，眸子微动，暗自思忖：

“今日就不出去了，毕竟在外人看来，我登八重天梯受了重伤，再加上还耗尽心神为韩如雪提供了半个时辰的纯阳真气，理应好好调息，而不是到处瞎逛。
否则容易引人怀疑，尤其是韩如雪。”
一念及此。
他不再犹豫，收起令牌，走到自己的床上，盘膝而坐，准备修行韩如雪给他的帝级功法九阳神功，若要伪装得像，这门功法是必须要修行的。
content_en:
The Holy Lady's Hall is elegant and quiet. Rare spiritual herbs and holy medicines are planted on both sides of the corridor. The afterglow of the setting sun pours down, coating the entire temple with a warm golden glow.
The spiritual plants are lingering with radiant light, the fragrant floral fragrance and the mellow medicinal gas are intertwined and blended, drifting in the wind, refreshing the heart and lungs, making people feel peaceful and peaceful.
Compared with other places in the sect, the spiritual energy in this hall is purer and more profound, making it the top place of enlightenment in the sect.
The maid's footsteps were light and she led Li Yi all the way to the most secluded west side hall of the Holy Lady's Hall.
The hall is spotless, surrounded by spiritual mist. The tables, chairs and beds are all made of thousand-year-old warm jade. The air is filled with a faint yin and yang energy. The cultivation background and environment are far beyond the residences of most core disciples of the sect.
The maid bowed her head:
"Senior Shi, the Holy Lady has ordered that this place will be your exclusive residence from now on. Your servant will live in the secluded house next door. If Senior has any needs, just summon him at any time."
"Very well, go and do your own thing."
Li Yi nodded slightly, with a calm expression.
The maid said no more, bowed and retreated, gently closing the palace door.
The moment the palace door closed, Li Yi immediately raised his hand and waved, and five Taoist talismans flew out, turning into five streams of light that divided the five directions. In an instant, a thin barrier was constructed, tightly covering the entire side hall, blocking all sounds from leaking out and divine consciousness exploration.
Subsequently.
He took out the jade slip of the Imperial Pure Yang Technique given by Han Ruxue, his consciousness sank into it, and the magnificent and mysterious Chunyang Dao Heart Technique instantly came into his mind.
"The Hehuan Sect's emperor-level Pure Yang Kung Fu is orthodox in Taoism and can be practiced up to the perfection of the Heavenly God Realm. It is quite suitable for the identity I am currently pretending to be."
Li Yi whispered to himself, recognizing Han Ruxue's character a little more in his heart.
In the eyes of ordinary cultivators, this technique is a heaven-defying opportunity, but in his case, it is just a cover to deceive others.
He practiced the Yin-Yang Chaos Sutra, the Heaven Refining Technique, the Taiyi Swallowing Heaven Technique, the Eight-nine Heaven-Tong Tian Xuan Gong and other supreme techniques, which far surpassed the emperor-level techniques.
He did not rush to practice this technique with concentration, but memorized the entire technique by heart, and then began to count the cultivation resources on the table.
There are a dazzling array of holy medicines, sacred springs, holy spiritual stones, spiritual nourishing and strengthening Taoist elixirs, etc. They are all rare treasures of the Hehuan Sect. If any one of them strays to the outside world, it is enough to trigger many monks to fight for it.
Li Yi tapped his fingertips to organize all the resources into categories.
After doing all this, he held up the gentle Concentric Covenant in his palm.
On the token, the parallel lotus pattern shimmers with translucent white, and the strands of mysterious vaginal charm wrap around the fingertips, vaguely resonating with Han Ruxue who is in retreat in the main hall.
A careful perceptual exploration.
Li Yi couldn't help but sigh: "This is actually a low-grade Taoist weapon. As the Hehuan Sect is one of the top three forces on the Fairy Star, it has a deep foundation. It is truly worthy of its reputation and its handiwork is truly amazing."
Immediately.
With a thought in his mind, he forced out a drop of pure pale golden divine blood from his fingertips, and accurately landed on the parallel lotus heart in the center of the token.
"Zi..."
The essence and blood enter the jade, and are instantly absorbed and dissolved by the token without any leakage.
The crystal clear jade order suddenly lit up with a soft halo of yin and light, the lotus patterns bloomed layer by layer, and the two rhymes of one yin and one yang came out, bound to Li Yi's soul.
In an instant.
All the mysterious functions and manipulation methods of the token were reflected clearly in Li Yi's sea of ​​consciousness.
This Taoist token has three powerful skills.
The first, and most important, is that it can transmit sound to another concentric device through the air, sense each other's position, and can even pass through most barriers or restricted isolation, and the sensing distance can reach hundreds of millions of miles away.
Second, access to the non-core restricted areas of the 108 peaks of the Hehuan Sect, including the Enlightenment Hall and the Sutra Pavilion.
Thirdly, when encountering a fatal crisis, the strongest barrier protection can be activated instantly to withstand the offensive of ordinary god kings for a quarter of an hour, while at the same time sending a distress signal and the final precise location to the sect's highest information altar.
"It's really the right time to come to Xuanyin Peak today. Not only do you get access to the whole peak of TongxingHe also has a profound relationship with the sect leader's direct disciple and the first saint, and is a big step closer to obtaining the Yin-Yang Chaos Sutra. "
A satisfied smile appeared at the corner of Li Yi's mouth.
For him.
Offending the top talents like Huang Chongxiao and Bai Qitian is nothing but a trivial matter. As long as we can approach the goal step by step, all the troubles can be resolved calmly.
Li Yi rubbed the jade order in his palm, his eyes moved slightly, and he thought to himself:
"I won't go out today. After all, in the eyes of outsiders, I was seriously injured when I climbed the eighth-level ladder. In addition, I also exhausted my energy to provide Han Ruxue with pure Yang Qi for half an hour. I should regulate my breath well instead of wandering around.
Otherwise, it would easily arouse suspicion, especially Han Ruxue. "
Just think of this.
He no longer hesitated, put away the token, walked to his bed, sat cross-legged, and prepared to practice the Nine Yang Divine Art, the emperor-level technique given to him by Han Ruxue. If he wanted to pretend to be like him, he had to practice this technique.
